scene: The brass pasta spinner whirs, spitting neon strands across the piazza.
picture: Flat side-view along the cobblestone ground. On the left, the silver-haired grandmother in a pink tracksuit holds her white dog on a lead. In the centre, the large brass pasta spinner whirs, spitting glowing noodles from a spout beside a red crank. On the far right stands a stone doorway with beaded curtains.
shown: a cascade of glowing pink noodles tumbling out of the brass spout in the centre
a sturdy red hand-crank attached to the machine's side on the left
an open arched doorway with beaded curtains on the far right
